title: Need to create analytical graphs of the instantsearch results
body:
Is the the any way to create analytics graphs of the instantsearch resultats. For example, if we
do a search on the films and we want to display some analytics graphs showing the istribution of films by category or year or ...
I thought to add a custom widget that creates the graphics.  I've read through both instantsearch docs and the helper docs but just not getting it. I don't find how to get the resultas values !! Can anyone guide me on creating this? Or suggest me another solution ?

Thank you and any help would be great!
